MonkeyKing|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter, a master of deception and engage. Nimbus Strike (E) dashes onto a target (clones hit other nearby enemies), Crushing Blow (Q) empowers his next attack and shreds armor, Warrior Trickster (W) dashes him while making him invisible and leaves a clone in his place, and Cyclone (R) makes him spin, knocking enemies into the air (two casts possible). His passive Stone Skin boosts his resistances and regeneration.
MonkeyKing|jgl.playstyle: Gank, skirmish and teamfight-engage jungler. His double ultimate knocks up several enemies in teamfights.
MonkeyKing|jgl.early_game: Clear fast with E and Q. Gank from level 3: E to dash in, Q for the empowered attack, W to dodge or fool the enemy with your clone. You win a lot of early duels.
MonkeyKing|jgl.level_2: Crushing Blow (Q). An empowered attack that shreds armor: E → Q is your basic combo.
MonkeyKing|jgl.level_3: Warrior Trickster (W). An invisible dash with a clone: to fool the enemy, dodge an ability or reposition. First gank: E → Q → attacks → W if the target fights back.
MonkeyKing|jgl.level_6: Cyclone: you spin, knocking enemies into the air, and you can recast it a second time. In teamfights, E onto a target in the middle of the group, then R twice: several enemies stay airborne for a long time.
MonkeyKing|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear, ganks and invades. Wukong wins early duels: invade when your laners have priority and control Scuttles. Play Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons with your team: your ultimate makes objective fights very dangerous for the enemy.
MonkeyKing|jgl.trading: Ganking: E → Q → attacks → W to fool them. Teamfighting: E into the middle of the group → R → R. Give up on it against tanks who soak damage or junglers who protect their allies (Ivern).
threats: Gwen, Ivern and Cho'Gath, among the worst matchups according to the data.
CC that stops you before your ultimate.
mistakes: Using W to open instead of saving it to dodge.
Casting your ultimate on a single target in teamfights.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Fool him with your clone when he casts Q.
matchup_notes.Graves: Stick to him with E and Q.
matchup_notes.Viego: Knock him up with your ultimate before he possesses your allies.
matchup_notes.Master Yi: Knock him up the moment he enters a teamfight.
matchup_notes.Cho'Gath: His silence cuts off your ultimate: wait until he's used it.

MonkeyKing|jgl.late_game: Teamfight engage: E into the middle of the group, then double Cyclone.
MonkeyKing|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler, take objectives and force fights.
MonkeyKing|jgl.behind: Farm and play for a decisive engage with your ultimate.
MonkeyKing|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win early skirmishes and engage teamfights with your double Cyclone.
MonkeyKing|jgl.final_tip: Save Warrior Trickster to dodge the enemy's key ability: your clone fools them.
